fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 36% match is a WEAK FIT for this Customer Success Manager role at Datadog.

**Strengths:**
- Workshop facilitation and training 12 colleagues, which supports customer onboarding
- Termly spreadsheet progress reports presented to senior leadership
- Self-taught Python (pandas), plus Python for Everybody certificate (2024)

**Gaps:**
- No 5-7 years in a customer account facing role
- No sales experience: negotiation, upselling, cross-selling, full sales cycle
- No MEDDIC or Command of the Message training

**Recommendation:** Build commercial experience first, through an entry-level customer success or onboarding role at a tech company, before applying to this senior position.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes a Customer Success Manager who builds mutual trust, explains the value of the Datadog product clearly and spots adoption problems early. Those are the problems I deal with as Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy in Leeds, where I run weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students. Each call means explaining complex information plainly to people with different levels of background knowledge, then keeping the relationship steady over time.

I'm a physics teacher with 8 years in the classroom, and I'm moving into customer education and success. I track student progress in Excel and Google Sheets and present the results to senior leadership each term, which is the same habit as monitoring usage trends and flagging what needs attention. I wrote the department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, so onboarding adults and collaborating across teams is familiar ground. I'm comfortable with data, and I've built on that with Python for Everybody (Coursera, 2024) and the Google Data Analytics Certificate, which I'm completing. I haven't worked in a commercial account role, and I'd bring a quick-learning, customer-minded approach to the sales side, which your MEDDIC and Command of the Message training would help me build on.

I'd welcome a conversation about how my teaching background could support your Boston customer base, and I'm available to speak at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

I run weekly parent calls and two parents' evenings a term for a year group of 210 students, so building trust with people who rely on me and explaining complex things clearly is already my daily work. I've also trained 12 colleagues on a curriculum I wrote and I present progress data to senior leadership each term, which is the kind of onboarding and usage-trend work this role involves. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a call any weekday afternoon after 4pm UK time, and I can start a conversation about notice period whenever suits you.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

followUpEmail.subject: Following Up: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
followUpEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

I applied for the Customer Success Manager role last week and remain keen. Datadog's focus on building mutual trust with customers, and growing existing accounts, is exactly where I want to work. At Ashgrove Academy I raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years, which shows how I turn steady relationship work into measurable results. I would welcome the chance to discuss how that approach could help your customers.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
